notes.title: NEW PATCH
notes.notes:
Dear players, many thanks to everyone who has helped us by reporting bugs and problems in Top Racer Collection.

We've collected all the feebacks and have just released the first patch, Which brings many fixes.

[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed memory crash in online mode
[*] Fixed some localized text 
[*] Rebalanced difficulty in Time Attack mode of Top Racer 3000
[*] Fixed leader board list navigation in Time Attack mode
[*] Minor UI adjustments
[/list]


If you have any problems with the game or find any bugs, let us know on the Steam forum and Discord!


Thanks everyone and have a great week!

notes.title: IMPORTANT NOTICE - NEW RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Dear gamer community,

It is with appreciation and responsibility that we share an important update on the long-awaited release of Top Racer Collection, scheduled for January 11, 2024. After careful consideration, we have decided to postpone the release in order to enhance the experience we want to deliver to all players.

We believe this decision will result in a more polished, higher quality game that meets the expectations of our incredible community. We are dedicating additional time to perfecting the details and ensuring that Top Racer Collection fully meets the standards we set out to achieve.

We understand that the news may cause frustration, so we want to express our sincere apologies to all the fans and supporters who are eager to dive into this exciting return to a beloved console classic.

In recognition of the invaluable ongoing support and patience of our community, we also want to offer something special by way of thanks. 

[b]On January 11, we will be making an exclusive demo of the game available for free on Steam. With this, we want to give everyone a sneak preview of what's to come.[/b]

We deeply appreciate your understanding. No one is more eager than we are to share Top Racer Collection in its best and most exciting form. We believe that this short wait will be rewarded with an exceptional gaming experience.

Count on us as we work tirelessly to deliver a game that you all deserve.
